axis: one worker growing: one task manager container capped at N cores, parallelism N, N slots
apiLevel: Flink DataStream API, this repository's own PositionsJob (no SQL, no Table API)

guarantee.sink: at-least-once, idempotent by emitting the absolute position per key

_articleRig: The published demo's own jars (demo-under-harness, built 2026-09-10) re-measured under the 2026-09-24 harness. One change from the published config: kafkaMemory 4g -> 4352m, because today's page-cache floor (3.25 GB) refuses 4g with a 1G heap. Nothing else changed. keySets added (tells preflight where the manifest keeps the keys; the job does not read it). The published 4,096-key run set SYMBOL_COUNT=4096 and ACCOUNT_COUNT=4 in the environment (demo-under-harness.md); this rig is run with the same. The published table was a --quick look (2 passes per case, publishable: false); this one uses the config's 3 passes.
